import sys, json
data = json.load(sys.stdin)["body"]
turns = data.get("messages", [])
calls = [t for t in turns if t.get("type") == "tool_call"]
out = []
for c in calls:
    out.append({
        "header": {"msg_type": "tool_call", "tool_call_id": c.get("id", "")},
        "messages": [c],
    })
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(out))
